src: tools/blender/trees (build_trees.py geometry + textures, upload_trees.py upload). Procedural Blender only.
units: studs, Roblox axes (+Y up). pivot = the tree's root on the ground (data/harvest/trees.json root x 2.5).
placement: model = InsertService:LoadAsset(assetId):GetChildren()[1] (a Model named displayName). Its pivot is the FBX origin = the tree root, so model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pivot[1], pivot[2], pivot[3])) puts every MeshPart at pivot + parts[name].center (verified by tools/cloud/tasks/tree_load.luau: sizes and centres exact). Anchor all parts. Bark carries the climbing surfaces (trunk radius = the squirrel's tapered radius r(1 - 0.48 t), giants r/0.95 - 2.625 t; bough tops = rail + lift) and keeps collision; set CanCollide/CanQuery false and CastShadow true on Leaves*/Apples. Pivot y is the harvested ground height at the root; the trunk carries 3 studs of bark below it for terrain mismatch.

partRoles.Bark: trunk, roots, boughs, bridges, twigs, lookout pads (collide)
partRoles.LeavesSun: sunlit top clumps, willow curtains (no collide)
